plugins.name: rights-by-design
plugins.description: AI Constitutional Engineering Framework. Assess or design any AI system for citizen rights at the design stage — privacy, due process, equal protection, contestability, accountability, and mission-critical safeguards — with sector modules for government, law enforcement, healthcare, finance and insurance, employment, education, telecom, defense, space, critical infrastructure, energy, transportation, robotics, manufacturing, biometrics, and smart cities. Produces a rights-by-design scorecard, sector-specific controls, and fixes.
